diabetes_pct.label: Census-reported diabetes
diabetes_pct.description: Share of usual residents who told the Census they have been diagnosed with diabetes by a doctor or nurse.
caveats: Census-reported diagnosed long-term diabetes, not clinical prevalence.
Excludes gestational diabetes; does not identify diabetes type or severity.
Not age-standardised: towns with older populations will tend to show higher rates.
Small towns: based on a small denominator and can swing sharply on a handful of people. Treat as indicative, not a precise underlying rate.
diabetes_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

indigenous_pct.label: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander population
indigenous_pct.description: Share of usual residents who identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.
caveats: Shown as descriptive Census context only.
Not a disease, deficit, or evaluative measure, and not available as a map colour layer.
indigenous_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

degree_pct.label: Degree-level qualification
degree_pct.description: Share of usual residents with a bachelor degree, postgraduate degree, or graduate diploma/certificate.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
degree_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

low_income_pct.label: Lower-income households
low_income_pct.description: Share of households in nil-income or lower weekly equivalised-income categories (below $650/week).
caveats: Household-level share, not a per-person share.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
low_income_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

unemployed_residents_pct.label: Unemployed residents
unemployed_residents_pct.description: Unemployed usual residents as a share of all usual residents.
caveats: Denominator is all usual residents, not the labour force — this is not the conventional unemployment rate.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
unemployed_residents_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

labour_force_residents_pct.label: Labour force participation
labour_force_residents_pct.description: Usual residents in the labour force as a share of all usual residents.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
labour_force_residents_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

crowded_pct.label: People in crowded dwellings
crowded_pct.description: Share of enumerated people living in crowded dwellings.
caveats: Denominator is enumerated population (place counted), not usual residents.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
crowded_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

social_housing_pct.label: People in social housing
social_housing_pct.description: Share of enumerated people in social housing dwellings.
caveats: Denominator is enumerated population (place counted), not usual residents.
Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
social_housing_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

need_assistance_pct.label: Need for core assistance
need_assistance_pct.description: Share of usual residents needing assistance with core activities (self-care, mobility, communication) due to disability, long-term illness, or old age.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
need_assistance_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder

born_overseas_nes_pct.label: Born overseas (non-English-speaking country)
born_overseas_nes_pct.description: Share of usual residents born overseas in a predominantly non-English-speaking country.
caveats: Descriptive Census context, not a ranking of towns.
born_overseas_nes_pct.source: ABS 2021 Census of Population and Housing, TableBuilder
